item: Pitch 2 item 10 A (Workshop machines): one pixel capsule machine per roulette, and the odds chips' eggs
egg_note: the odds chip egg of each rarity (Config.MachineSheet.Eggs): 9 x 9 cells + its 1-cell drop shadow (Text at 30 %); 3 px a cell on PC (27 px), 2 on a phone (18). Without its cell the game draws PixelIcon "egg_<rarity>", the same drawing in Frames
cell_note: w x h = the drawing (52 x 60, the Secret 60 x 68) + its 1-cell drop shadow on the right and bottom
upload: ONE Image asset (not a Decal id), from the owner's keyed cloud session; then set Config.MachineSheet.Id to its image id. Until then (Id = 0) every roulette keeps today's drawn machine (ShopEggs H.machine).
draw: ImageLabel, Image rbxassetid://<id>, ImageRectOffset (x, y), ImageRectSize (w, h), ResampleMode Pixelated, a whole number of screen px a cell (3 on PC for the hero's vault, 2 in a PC card, 2 or 1 on a phone)
